def firstExitFrontierCandidates {α : Type*} (k : ℕ)
    (parent : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ) (carrier : List α) :
    List (FirstExitDepthState α) :=
  (firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h [] true 1 carrier).flatMap fun state =>
    firstExitNextSelectionCandidates h state.selectedPrefix state.positive state.mass
      state.remaining
sources.role: Literal next-selection candidates before own admission.

sources.raw_excerpt:
theorem firstExitFrontierCandidates_weighted_sum_eq_tuple_sum (k : ℕ)
    (parent : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ) (carrier : List ℕ)
    (hc : carrier.Nodup) (f : (Fin (k + 1) → ℕ) → ℝ) :
    ((firstExitFrontierCandidates k parent h carrier).map (fun state =>
      (state.selectedPrefix.map (fun q : ℕ => 1 / ((q : ℝ) - 1))).prod *
        f (primeHistoryTuple (k + 1) state.selectedPrefix))).sum =
      ∑ p ∈ firstExitFrontierTuples k parent carrier,
        (∏ i, 1 / ((p i : ℝ) - 1)) * f p := by
  rw [← firstExitFrontierCandidates_sum_eq_tuple_sum k parent h carrier hc
    (fun p => (∏ i, 1 / ((p i : ℝ) - 1)) * f p)]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro state hs
  rw [primeHistoryTuple_reciprocal_mass
    (firstExitFrontierCandidates_selected_length k parent h carrier state hs)]
sources.role: Exact arbitrary signed tuple-test weighted reindex, final f argument is explicit.

theorem mem_actualPrimeFrontierTuples_iff_of_cutoff_le_cap (k : ℕ)
    (parent : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (N cap : ℕ) (w z : ℝ)
    (hzcap : z ≤ (cap : ℝ)) (p : Fin (k + 1) → ℕ) :
    p ∈ firstExitFrontierTuples k parent (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) ↔
      StrictAnti p ∧
        (∀ i, Nat.Prime (p i) ∧ ¬p i ∣ N ∧
          w ≤ (p i : ℝ) ∧ (p i : ℝ) < z) ∧
        FirstExitValidSelection parent [] true (List.ofFn p).dropLast := by
  rw [mem_firstExitFrontierTuples_iff_of_decreasing k parent _
    (roughPrimeUniverse_pairwise_gt N cap w z)]
sources.role: Same cutoff<=enumeration-cap prime carrier and proper-prefix admission.

noncomputable def FirstExitValidSelection {α : Type*}
    (retained : Bool → List α → Bool) (pre : List α) (positive : Bool) : List α → Prop
  | [] => True
  | p :: ps => retained (!positive) (p :: pre) = true ∧
      FirstExitValidSelection retained (p :: pre) (!positive) ps
sources.role: Actual recursive policy checks on processing-order proper selections.

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_through_two (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (positive : Bool) (history : List ℕ) (hlen : history.length ≤ 2) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N positive history =
      actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N positive history := by
  simp only [actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy, thirdCappedUpperPolicy,
    firstExitDepthSplicePolicy, if_pos hlen]

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_even (e h : ℝ) (m N : ℕ)
    (history : List ℕ) : actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy e h m N true history = true := by
  apply UpperPolicyFiniteBridge.thirdCappedUpperPolicy_even_retained
  intro pre
  simp [actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy, oddFirstExitPolicy]
sources.role: Same compact policy through-two and even-retention suppliers.

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy_first_of_cell {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 < N) (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384)
    (hmesh : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m ≤ e / 2)
    (p0 p1 p2 : ℕ) (hp0 : 0 < p0) {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m)
    (ht : primeHistoryLogCoordinates (N : ℝ) 3 [p2, p1, p0] ∈ actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy e m N false [p0] = true := by
  have hNr : (1 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  apply (actualExtendedThirdCompactInitialPolicy_first_iff e m N p0 hp0).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, actualExtendedThirdCompactFirstStop_of_cell p0 p1 p2 hj ht⟩
  exact (actualExtendedThirdCompactCell_prime_firstCube hN he0 he hmesh p0 p1 p2 hp0 hj ht).trans_le
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNr.le
      (thirdPrefixBufferedCap_le_root e (actualExtendedThirdPhysicalGamma e m j)))

/-- The actual cap's already proved first-cube margin pays that inherited
test at the third admission, even though the new level may be smaller. -/
theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactUpperPolicy_third_iff {e h : ℝ} {m N : ℕ}
    (hN : 1 < N) (he0 : 0 < e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384)
    (hmesh : actualExtendedThirdDyadicStep m ≤ e / 2)
